abstract: A 42-year-old male presented with bilateral scrotal swelling and sense of abdominal fullness. Ultrasonography and computed tomographic (CT) scan showed right testicular tumor, left scrotal hydrocele and excessive ascites, but no distant metastases. The serum lactic acid dehydrogenase (LDH) value was as high as 4,060 IU/L and beta human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) value was 4.0 ng/ml while alpha fetoprotein (AFP) value was within the normal range. Right high orchiectomy was performed as well as the ascites and the left scrotal fluid sampling. Histological examinations revealed anaplastic seminoma in the right testis, and similar cells were found in the ascites and the left scrotal fluid. The patient received three courses of BEP chemotherapy consisting of bleomycin, VP-16 and cisplatin. The ascites and tumor markers (LDH and beta hCG) decreased markedly. Intraperitoneal dissemination of the tumor cells seems to be caused by invasion along the right spermatic cord, but the route of dissemination into the left hydrocele fluid is not known. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first case report of testicular tumor that showed intraperitoneal dissemination without any evidence of metastasis to the lymph nodes or distant organs.
abstract_ja: 42歳の男性が、両側陰嚢の腫脹と腹部膨満感を訴えて来院した。超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、右精巣腫瘍、左陰嚢水瘤、多量の腹水を認めたが、遠隔転移は認めなかった。血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)値は4,060 IU/Lと著明に高値で、β-hCGは4.0 ng/ml、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常範囲内であった。右高位精巣摘除術を施行するとともに、腹水および左陰嚢液の採取を行った。右精巣の病理組織学的検査で未分化セミノーマと診断され、同様の細胞が腹水および左陰嚢液にも認められた。患者はブレオマイシン、VP-16、シスプラチンからなるBEP化学療法を3コース受けた。腹水および腫瘍マーカー(LDHおよびβ-hCG)は著明に減少した。腫瘍細胞の腹腔内播種は右精索に沿った浸潤によると考えられるが、左陰嚢水瘤液への播種経路は不明である。われわれの知る限り、リンパ節や遠隔臓器への転移を伴わずに腹腔内播種を示した精巣腫瘍の症例報告としては初めてである。
